reviewer: metadata/archive reviewer (not the lead who inserted the comments)
scope: Independent byte/hash reconstruction and comment/header/copyright review of exactly 170 lead-recorded notice insertions. Not a library test, compile, semantic equivalence or release-certification run.
method: Strictly parsed the lead receipt and required 170 unique paths (169 imported paths and one explicit CupertinoSlider relocation).

Read actual current bytes and required exact recorded after hashes/lengths. Removed exactly the one UTF-8 insertion at its byte offset, checked reconstructed before hashes/lengths, and reinserted it to recreate the current file.
Independently cross-checked reconstructed pre-change hashes against the earlier captured 903-file selected-marker inventory; any mismatch is retained rather than inferred satisfied.

Checked each inserted line as a language-native comment, its explicit changed-file notice and its position relative to XML declarations, shebangs/BOMs and file start. Parsed the two XML trees before/after ignoring comments.
Read original source Git blobs at the imported baseline. Checked all detected copyright lines and copyright-containing comment blocks verbatim; the relocated slider uses its original iOS path.
Compared LICENSE with imported baseline bytes and the lead hash; compared LICENSE, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with the named development base.
Rehashed all 170 current source files and both input receipts at the end to detect observed concurrent edits.
limitations: Byte-exact removal proves this recorded delta consists only of the indicated comment bytes; it is not independent compilation or runtime/device verification.
The earlier scan is a prior snapshot, not a current privacy/security clearance. Its receipt explicitly records selected-marker and ignored-file limitations.
Detected original copyright/comment preservation is not exhaustive legal clearance for all dependencies, fonts, distributions, or newly derived source files.
The 47 existing-notice files have current notice presence and prior whole-file hashes reported separately; they are not part of the 170 reconstruction assertions.
Prior build/device receipts remain bound to their original source bytes. A post-notice producer build must record fresh hashes; this review does not relabel historical test results.
A later source or receipt edit invalidates these current-hash observations. The review does not lift containment, publish anything or mark audit findings verified.
